title: Bib Fortuna
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: Bib Fortuna was the loyal majordomo to Jabba the Hutt. An imposing Twi'lek, he spoke for Jabba and was the key to gaining access to Jabba and all of his business dealings at his Tatooine palace. Bib served Jabba for decades, learning to deal with the Hutt's impatience, mercurial moods, and outright hostility, such as when he would drop those that displeased him into the pit of his rancor. Bib Fortuna was susceptible to Jedi mind tricks and, against Jabba's wishes, granted Luke Skywalker an audience with the great, exalted Hutt.
